message:
Most AI agents are just a for loop with a prompt.

Here are the 8 patterns that actually make them work — 4 for a single agent (tool use, ReAct, plan & execute, agentic RAG), 4 for getting multiple agents to work together (sequential, parallel, router, orchestrator-worker).

I wrote all 8 up with code examples and the exact way each one breaks in production.

Comment "guide" and I'll send it over.
